data.name: Qadeem
data.gender_notes: Qadeem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Someone who is old in age or experience, someone who has been around for a long time, someone who is wise and has a deep understanding of the world and its workings. The name Qadeem carries the meaning “Ancient, Old, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qadeem usually hope their child will grow to embody ancient, old, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for someone who carries the wisdom and knowledge of the ancestors, someone who embodies the ancient wisdom and traditions of the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Qadeem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ancient, Old, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qadeem total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qadeem (pronounced "Kadd-eem") in Arabic culture carries a sense of respect and veneration. It is associated with the concept of elders, wisdom, and age-old traditions. It is a title that is often given to esteemed figures in Islam, such as scholars, religious leaders, and community elders. In a broader sense, it represents the preservation of knowledge, history, and wisdom through the ages.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Qadeem holds deep spiritual significance in Islam as it signifies the timeless nature of God's existence and wisdom. The Quran mentions in multiple instances that God is the Al-Qadeem, the Eternal One, who was there before all creation. The name is also reminiscent of thehadith that states, "The Prophet (peace be upon him) said, 'A woman is the pillar of her home. If she is wise, they are wise; if she is foolish, they are foolish.' He then raised his hands and supplicated, 'O Allah, boost my people in the knowledge that will benefit them.' " (Narrated by Bukhari and Muslim). The name Qadeem can encourage us to seek wisdom, knowledge, and understanding, and to become pillars of wisdom and guidance for our communities, just as the elders before us have been.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Ancient, Old, Wise" symbolizes Someone who is old in age or experience, someone who has been around for a long time, someone who is wise and has a deep understanding of the world and its workings.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Qadeem serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of ancient, old, wise.
